The structure of Mg6Cr8N12 (reduced formula Mg3Cr4N6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr and Mg centers each coordinated by six N neighbors, while N centers have seven geometric neighbors (3 Cr, 4 Mg). Cr and Mg polyhedra display corner- and edge-sharing, and N-centered 7-vertex polyhedra show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
